items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I hear in Louie vein and a Coleman Hawkins vein.

ctx.x: So, I said, 'That's the kind of horn I want to play, I want to play that.' That's a funny thing about my playing and my hearing of tunes. Whenever I hear a tune, I hear it in two veins. I hear in Louie vein and a Coleman Hawkins vein. And I can duplicate either one for you on the paper.
Uh-huh. Louie's very lyrical, Hawk is very vertical (very vocal) -- harmonic player.
